text: I stay OPPOSE on my own test. Lens coil warn means no tight base and so no pivot (R3); day_vol 1.03 is under 1.40 (C16). W swing HH but LL, D 1.2% under 20-day high is a drift, not a breakout. minervini's ma_50/ma_100 and rs_rank_pct are not on my menu; I do not rule on them. Regime: market gate delegated, no read written. Wrong if a tight base completes and it breaks pivot_high on day_vol of at least 1.40.
